name: understand-book
description: Operator-only local build tools. Requires explicitly provisioned maintenance executables; cloud Windows Setup does not install this plugin.

interface.longDescription: Build local reading bases in an explicitly provisioned operator environment. Ordinary cloud learners use the website or Windows app and configure remote read-only Book MCP from their account.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $understand-book-build to build a book or trusted paper workspace.
